name: teleclaw
description: Spawn Hermes always-on AI agents as a service. Each agent runs Hermes Agent 24/7 on its own cloud computer with a browser, memory and skills. Create agents from a description and manage their instructions, model, skills, apps, memory and scheduled tasks from ChatGPT, with zero ops.

interface.longDescription:
Spawn Hermes always-on AI agents as a service. TeleClaw runs Hermes Agent, the open-source AI agent by Nous Research, for you: each agent gets its own cloud computer with a web browser, memory and skills, and keeps working 24/7. No servers to run, no API keys, zero ops.

Spin up an agent from a plain-language description, then give it work: answer customers, research and write, go through your email and docs, post a daily digest or run reports on a schedule. Agents talk to people in Telegram and Slack, and you manage them from ChatGPT.

With this app, ask ChatGPT to:

- Spawn a new Hermes agent from a description (you finish by creating its Telegram bot with one tap)
- Change an agent's instructions, persona, behavior or AI model
- Schedule recurring tasks such as digests, reports and reminders, then change, pause or delete them
- Give an agent skills, MCP servers and apps such as Gmail and Notion
- Teach an agent facts to remember, and read or delete what it remembers
- See all your agents, copy one agent's setup to another, or delete an agent

You sign in with Telegram and allow ChatGPT once. The app only reaches the agents your TeleClaw account owns. Installing a skill, adding or re-pointing an MCP server, copying a setup and deleting an agent each wait for your Approve tap in the @claw chat, so nothing risky happens without you. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time in TeleClaw Settings, Connected AI apps.
capabilities: Spawn Hermes AI agents from a description
Edit agent instructions, persona and AI model
Add skills, MCP servers and apps like Gmail and Notion
defaultPrompt: Spawn an always-on agent that sends me a daily AI news digest
Create a Hermes agent that answers customer questions 24/7
Which of my agents are running and what do they do?

positive.prompt: Which TeleClaw agents do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's three active agents: its main agent TeleClaw, plus Support Assistant and News Digest.

positive.description: Show how an agent is set up
positive.prompt: Show me the instructions of my Support Assistant agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Support Assistant and shows its persona and rules: it answers customer questions about the fictional Orbitly app politely and briefly.

positive.prompt: Make my Support Assistant always answer in a friendly tone and end each answer by asking whether anything else is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates Support Assistant's rules with the new tone and closing question and confirms the change. No Telegram approval is needed for this edit.

positive.prompt: Every weekday at 9:00, have my News Digest agent post a short AI news summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an enabled task on News Digest that runs at 9:00 Monday to Friday with the summary prompt, and shows its schedule.

positive.description: Save something to an agent's memory
positive.prompt: Remember for my Support Assistant that our office hours are 9:00 to 18:00 CET, Monday to Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a note with the office hours to Support Assistant's memory and confirms it; asking what the agent remembers then lists it.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not done on one request: the app asks which agent, and every deletion waits for the owner's Approve tap in Telegram
Broadcasting messages to an agent's users is outside the app; it manages agents, it does not send messages for them
negative.prompt: Send a message from my Support Assistant to all of its users right now.

negative.description: The app only reaches the signed-in account's own agents
negative.prompt: Show me the agents of another TeleClaw user.

review.commerce_description: TeleClaw does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Clearer listing: the name, subtitle, description and starter prompts now say what TeleClaw is, Hermes always-on AI agents as a service, so people looking for Hermes Agent hosting or always-on AI agents find it. No change to the tools or to data handling.
